entities.name: Tangled Vale
entities.description: Home forest of the Joraga elves, jungle valleys in southern Bala Ged on Zendikar.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: Continent of Zendikar overrun by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Joraga
entities.description: Warlike nomadic elf tribe of the vale, skilled trackers and scouts.

entities.name: Great Hollow Tree
entities.description: Site where the Joraga bury their dead.

entities.name: Makindi Empire
entities.description: Ancient kor empire the vale was once part of.

entities.name: Obuun
entities.description: Pre-spirit leader of the elven nations in the revolt against the kor.

entities.name: Release of the Eldrazi
entities.description: Event after which Bala Ged was overrun.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Used the Lithoform Core's healing power.

entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: Source of healing power used by Nissa.

events.summary: The elven nations, led by Obuun, revolt against their kor rulers and topple their Skyclave.
events.quote: revolted against their kor rulers and toppled their Skyclave

events.summary: Within two years of the Eldrazi's release, Bala Ged is overrun and destroyed.
events.quote: the entire continent of Bala Ged was overrun and destroyed

events.summary: Nissa uses the Lithoform Core's healing power and the vale begins to recover.
events.quote: the vale and the rest of the continent slowly started to recover

relations.note: The vale is their home forest.
relations.quote: The Tangled Vale is the home forest of the Joraga
lie in the southern portion of Bala Ged
